oracles: oracles/nonempty-props: per adapter >= 100k generated (capset, op) pairs; empty/absent/non-covering capsets must Deny before any render; covering capsets must Allow (non-vacuity)
ci/unrestricted.py: every `unrestricted` in any in-tree config's effective form is listed in ci/unrestricted.allow with a reason; the built-in default has none and no null/absent limit

acceptance.must: PASS; mutants empty-means-all, missing-capset-means-all, deny-everything (non-vacuity red), unrestricted-implicit (absent data block treated as unrestricted) caught within 1e4 cases; unrestricted.py red on fixtures with an unlisted unrestricted and with a null limit

notes: Deterministic in-oracle generator (seeded, no proptest dependency); protocol: {op:'authorize', adapter, capset, op} -> {decision:'allow'|'deny', rendered:bool}; a reply with rendered=true on deny is a violation (render must not be reached).
